name: Muzaffar Ahmad
contribution: Muzaffar Ahmad was a founding figure of communist politics in Bengal and an influential left intellectual.
context: His organising and writing placed labour, class, and anti-colonial struggle at the centre of debates often framed only through communal identity.
impact: He broadens the history of partition by showing how class politics and international socialism shaped Bengali political thought.

faq.answer: Muzaffar Ahmad is connected to the partition era as Left Political Thinker. He was a major left intellectual from Bengal whose politics highlighted class questions often overshadowed by communal narratives.
